summary.name: Deluge
summary.one_liner: Deluge is a lightweight, free, cross-platform BitTorrent client, per its listings on awesome-selfhosted and awesome-mac; the page itself only shows an Anubis bot-check and no product details.
summary.what_it_does: The fetched page is only an Anubis proof-of-work bot-check screen, so no Deluge feature descriptions were available from it. The description here relies on the awesome-selfhosted and awesome-mac listing text, which calls Deluge a lightweight, free, cross-platform BitTorrent client written in Python with GPL-3.0 source code. The listings do not describe specific features. The page also notes that Anubis needs modern JavaScript, so privacy plugins such as JShelter may block access.
